I purchased this one for my Maytag dryer when my heating element went out. I had tested this thermistor for continuity, but you need a higher resistance than just a simple continuity test. I received the new one and tested it and measured resistance. I then switched to a different resistance setting and was able to get a reading at room temperature. I then tested my old one and get a reading as well. So I sent this thermistor back.

The iFillCup K-cups are by far the best choice for refillable cups I've been able to find.  They're very well made, easy and quick to use.  They're also cost efficient.  I've tried almost every combination of refillable K-cup available and none compare to the quality of these cups.  By having the cup, lid, and filter pre-assembled, it makes using them a breeze; the lids fit snug without requiring much pressure. They're also truly Keurig 1 and 2.0 compatible, unlike other brands that make the claim of 2.0 compatibility.  Love these cups!

Although I do have a complaint I have to say this is a great product. The coffee from my Kuerig is better tasting and stronger. The cups seem to be good quality but have one fatal flaw.  Often (most of the time) the Keurig head does not fully puncture the lid of the cup.  Note that a normal k cup has a foil lid and this cup has a plastic lid.  When the Keurig head fails to punch through the lid of the k cup it cannot dispense the hot water and results in a mess.  I have found that I must pre-puncture the plastic lid of the k cup before I place it in the Keurig.  Then it works just fine.
